articles.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
articles.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

articles.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
articles.description: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

articles.title: Iranian academic writes of US detention 'hell' over link to 1979 hostage crisis
articles.description: The immigration status of Maryam Tahmasebi was revoked because her husband is the son of a prominent figure in Iran.

articles.title: US announces new sanctions on top ICC figures
articles.description: The Trump administration has vowed to dismantle the international court "brick by brick".

articles.title: US tourist killed by lightning strike on Mount Etna during hike in restricted area
articles.description: An American tourist has been killed by a lightning strike after hiking in a restricted part of Mount Etna.

articles.title: Trump downscales 'hostile' military drills with South Korea
articles.description: Joint US military exercises with South Korea will be downscaled, Donald Trump says, as they are "hostile" and too expensive.
